text:
"I walked to the harbour before dawn," Nell said. "The boats were already out,
and the gulls were following them.

"By noon the wind had turned. Nobody on the quay would say so, but every one
of them was watching the sky.

"So I came back here to tell you."

Her brother put down his cup.
